{"command":"cd /workspace/scratch/c0f3ec78c621/validation/audit-20261117/itbench-aa-r2/case-039/workspace && python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd,ast,os
files=['metrics/pod_frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95_raw.tsv','metrics/pod_frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-vmrpz_raw.tsv','metrics/pod_ad-554b849958-p226w_raw.tsv','metrics/pod_cart-755465879b-pdqqh_raw.tsv']
for f in files:
 d=pd.read_csv(f,sep='\t',usecols=['metric_name','timestamp','value','tags'],low_memory=False)
 d=d[(d.timestamp>='2025-12-15 17:35')&(d.timestamp<='2025-12-15 18:00')]
 x=d[d.metric_name.isin(['container_cpu_cfs_periods_total','container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total'])].copy()
 x['container']=x.tags.map(lambda t: ast.literal_eval(t).get('container','') if isinstance(t,str) else '')
 x=x[x.container!='']
 print('\n',os.path.basename(f))
 for cont,g in x.groupby('container'):
  p=g.pivot(index='timestamp',columns='metric_name',values='value').sort_index().apply(pd.to_numeric,errors='coerce').dropna()
  dp=p['container_cpu_cfs_periods_total'].diff(); dt=p['container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total'].diff(); ratio=dt/dp
  print(cont,'samples',len(p),'delta ratio',round(dt.sum()/dp.sum(),4),'avg interval ratio',round(ratio.mean(),4),'max interval',round(ratio.max(),4),'above25%',int((ratio>.25).sum()))
PY","timeout":120,"access":"full"}
